text: @gitdek ratifies from the dashboard without copying commands. The public page's Needs you cards link each to the same card on /act, and on /act several waiting plans, plumbing plans or plans of issues, can be ratified with one confirmation that lists each plan's issue, name and hash, each ratify still posted on its own issue as him. Until now only rebuilds that change no statement could be ratified together (D-0093); a proposal that changes statements still ratifies on its own. #150 builds it.
